words.example: I see, we will change the time.
Got it, I will print ten copies.
That makes sense, let's do it.
Fair enough, we can wait one day.
words.exampleZh: 可以理解，我们可以再等一天。

words.example: No problem, I can cover Thursday.
words.exampleZh: 没问题，周四我可以顶班。

words.example: Multicast carries the nurse-call alerts, so a missing querier silenced a whole floor.
words.exampleZh: 护士呼叫告警走组播，查询器一缺，整层楼就没了声音。

words.example: A broadcast from the bad printer NIC filled the clinic VLAN within a minute.
words.exampleZh: 那块坏掉的打印机网卡发出的广播，一分钟内灌满了门诊 VLAN。

words.meaning: 组播管理协议（Internet Group Management Protocol）
words.example: IGMP (Internet Group Management Protocol) snooping stopped the nurse-call flood from reaching every port.
words.exampleZh: IGMP（组播管理协议）侦听拦住了护士呼叫的泛洪，没有让它冲到每个端口。

words.example: Protocol independent multicast builds the tree that carries nurse-call video between closets.
words.exampleZh: 协议无关组播建好了树，护士呼叫的视频才在各个弱电间之间传送。

words.example: mDNS (Multicast DNS) from a personal printer answered names that belong to the hospital.
words.exampleZh: 一台个人打印机发出的 mDNS（组播域名）应答了本属于医院的名称。
